name: Notion
whatYouLose: A decade of polish in collaborative editing and block transforms
The marketplace of templates, integrations, and community-made systems
Reliable offline sync and conflict resolution across every device
prompt: Build a private team knowledge base with pages, nested documents, slash commands, markdown shortcuts, a block editor, a left navigation tree, full-text search, tags, backlinks, favorites, and a lightweight kanban database view. Use Astro server output, SQLite, accessible server-rendered HTML, and vanilla JavaScript. Include import/export for Markdown, optimistic saves, keyboard navigation, and a clean mobile layout. Ship seed content, migrations, tests, and a README with deployment steps. Do not add accounts; protect the app with one shared admin password from an environment variable.
notes: A focused internal wiki is very buildable. A universal workspace with real-time multiplayer and dozens of database views is not a one-prompt job.
